config.reload-key.name: Reload changed JSON files
config.reload-key.tooltip: Reloads changed i18n and Content Patcher JSON files. Close dialogues and menus before using it.
config.show-hud.name: Show in-game messages
config.show-hud.tooltip: Shows the reload result in the corner of the screen.
message.world-not-ready: Load a save before reloading content packs.
message.blocked: Close dialogues and menus, and finish the current event, before reloading.
message.no-changes: No changed Content Patcher JSON files were found.
message.invalid: Reload cancelled for {{count}} content pack(s): invalid JSON. Check the SMAPI console.
message.restart-needed: Some changed files require a restart or their own config menu. Check the SMAPI console.
message.integration-failed: The reload command couldn't be accessed. Check the SMAPI console.
